body:
छि
“Do you remember me sometimes? Because I do.”
from being
Best Friends for life
to not even being
. in close friends list
on Instagram
“Ss having muted
each other's statuses
on WhatsApp
ढ़ two people who couldn't
- 3 do without each other
है who couldn’t call it 8 day
. without sharing deets
॥ with each other
\ now feel miles apart
despite being present
in the same room.
author: Mohit Yenugwar
